## Recent talks

- Talks based on the article [Tail-Calibrated Estimation of Extreme Quantile Treatment Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.23309)
  - Invited talk given at the 2026 ISI RSC in Malta (more *stastsy*)
  - Invited talk given at the 2026 EXALT project workshop "Learning Spatio-Temporal Climate Extremes", for an audience including statisticians and climate scientists

- Invited talk **Learning Extremal Dependence with Normalising Flows**  given at the GAME 2026 workshop in Bologna, based on [the GPDFlow article](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.11822)
   

- Seminar talk **Data fusion and extremes: a match made in Bayesian heaven** given at the EPN seminar series in 2025, based on [Spatio-temporal fusion of reanalysis and in situ data for censored threshold exceedances of PM$_{2.5}$](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.20268)

## GLE²N
I'm co-founder of the Glasgow-Edinburgh Extremes Network, a joint effort between statistician in Glasgow and Edinburgh working on statistics of extremes. Visit the network homepage to know more!

- [GLE²N: Glasgow--Edinburgh Extremes Network](https://glen-scotland.github.io/glen/)
